item.title: Wilkes-Barre, Scranton first responders to battle on the ice Saturday
item.description: Firefighters and police officers from Wilkes-Barre and Scranton will battle for a trophy and bragging rights Saturday in the inaugural First Responders Hockey Match at Mohegan Arena in Wilkes-Barre Twp.

item.title: HS SWIMMING: Scranton Prep girls finish undefeated, win Lackawanna League title
item.description: Scranton Prep swimmers turned in a dominant performance on their way to an undefeated season in the Lackawanna League. Rebecca Oakes and Ella Schofield each had two individual events, and the Classics swept all three relays in a 106-70 win over Delaware Valley on Thursday to clinch the championship. Oakes, last season’s Times-Tribune Female Swimmer of the Year, won the 50-yard freestyle in 25.64 seconds and the 100 free (59.53). item.title: HS ROUNDUP: Scranton Prep, North Pocono girls finish tied in Division I
item.description: A playoff to determine the Lackawanna League Division I girls basketball title is necessary after Scranton Prep and North Pocono won their respective regular-season finales Thursday. However, one to determine the Division III championship is not. Elk Lake used a fourth-quarter surge to defeat No. 9 Montrose, 46-43. item.title: LOCAL COLLEGE: Lackawanna men get crucial victory
item.description: Lackawanna College kept its playoff hopes alive Thursday with an 82-68 win over Raritan Valley Community College in a NJCAA Region 19 Division II men’s basketball game at the Lackawanna College Student Union. Jaksa Pejovic had a double-double for the Falcons (4-6 region, 13-13 overall) with 22 points and 10 rebounds. item.title: Post 6082 pasta and meatball dinner
item.description: VFW Shopa Davey Post 6082 will hold a pasta and meatball dinner fundraiser Feb. 22 from 11 a.m.-3 p.m. at the post, 123 Electric St., Peckville, eat in or take out. Each dinner ticket is $15; open to the public with free parking. Tickets are available for presale at the post home. The Honor Guard of the post is sponsoring the fundraiser. item.title: HS SWIMMING: 10 swimmers to watch at Les Richards Championships
item.description: The top swimming athletes from around the region converge on Scranton High School this weekend for the Les Richards Championship meet. Action starts Friday at 4:30 p.m. with the diving competition. Then Saturday, swimmers hit the pool at 10 a.m. This season, the meet will be conducted with races on time, with the fastest-seeded athletes in the final heats. item.description: VFW Abington Memorial Post 7069, Clarks Summit, presented BSA Troop 251 with $500 in support of ongoing Scouting programs. From left: Michael McLane, quartermaster/adjutant, Post 7069; Chris Kane, representing Troop 251; and Donald Jones, Post 7069 commander.
